name: terraform-providers-map-bare-name
body: Provider meta-arguments resolve a bare name only on a provider attribute (provider = aws gives provider.aws); a bare name used as a value inside a providers object (providers = { aws = aws }) is not surfaced by the parse view, so it draws no edge, while traversal values such as aws.west still resolve to provider.aws.west. Upgrade by surfacing bare-variable values in the parse object walk when providers maps with bare names must link to provider.<name>.
